Generate a country prioritization workbook

generate_GSAP_ctry_prioritization.Rd

Calculate the GPSAP country-prioritization indicators and weighted scores using the package KPI calculations for AFP, ES, and detection timeliness. Population-immunity data are supplied explicitly because they are not part of the POLIS download.

Usage

generate_GSAP_ctry_prioritization(
  raw_data,
  start_date,
  end_date,
  immunity_data,
  risk_table = NULL,
  lab_locs = NULL,
  regional_classification = NULL,
  proposed_category = NULL,
  ctry_sf = NULL,
  category_breaks = NULL,
  min_surv_ind = 4,
  include_all_countries = FALSE,
  output_path = NULL,
  positive_end_date = Sys.Date(),
  lab_data = NULL
)

Arguments

raw_data

list Output of get_all_polio_data(). The data must be supplied by the calling template; this function does not download or save a separate POLIS R data file.

start_date

Date or date-like string. Start of the analysis period.

end_date

Date or date-like string. End of the analysis period.

immunity_data

tibble Country-level immunity data. It must contain Country (or country) and either zero.dose.pct, under.immun.pct, and no.ipv1.pct, or dtp1.pct, dtp3.pct, and ipv1.pct.

risk_table

tibble Previous country-priority table. It must contain Country and SG Priority Level. Defaults to the country-risk table retrieved from EDAV using CTRY_RISK_CAT.

lab_locs

tibble Laboratory-location data. Defaults to the package data source when NULL.

regional_classification

tibble Optional table with Country and a column named Regional classification.

proposed_category

tibble Optional table with Country and either Proposed GPSAP 2025-26 prioritization or SG Priority Level.

ctry_sf

sf Optional country spatial data used for proximity to virus detections. If omitted, raw_data$global.ctry is used when present.

category_breaks

numeric Optional named thresholds for assigning a proposed category from the total score. Names must include HIGH, MEDIUM, and LOW (WATCHLIST).

min_surv_ind

integer Minimum number of available surveillance indicators required for a complete score. Defaults to 4.

include_all_countries

logical Retain every country present in the AFP data, even when it has fewer than min_surv_ind indicators. Such countries receive insufficient data for the affected scores. Defaults to FALSE.

output_path

str Optional path for an Excel output. If NULL, no file is written.

positive_end_date

Date Date used as the end of the six- and twelve-month positive-detection and proximity windows. Defaults to Sys.Date().

lab_data

tibble Optional cleaned laboratory data containing DateStoolReceivedinLab. When supplied, this date is used for the C2 onset-to-laboratory timeliness indicator.

Value

A list with results, analysis_notes, and output_path.
